title: Optimizing Large Data Modification Statements knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Optimizing Large Data Modification Statements”?
options: It is a frontend styling feature and does not involve database behavior.
It guarantees correct output regardless of schema, permissions, or release version.
It is best handled by removing constraints and skipping error checks.

Data-changing statements should target the intended rows and preserve integrity. Use an explicit column list, a narrowly tested predicate, transactions where applicable, and a SELECT preview before destructive changes.
questions.answer_key: Data-changing statements should target the intended rows and preserve integrity. Use an explicit column list, a narrowly tested predicate, transactions where applicable, and a SELECT preview before destructive changes.
questions.explanation: The lesson explains: Data-changing statements should target the intended rows and preserve integrity. Use an explicit column list, a narrowly tested predicate, transactions where applicable, and a SELECT preview before destructive changes.
